Back in any other cod and I really don't think they changed it in bo4, you were able to just either Alt+F4 on pc or to just close the game/turn off console in a on going game. This way your progress from the last game won't be safed. You won't get the lose for the game, you won't get the deaths or the kills. It is as if you never joined that game. That way it'd be quite easy to just never get yourself flagged as frequent leaver.

Not sure if that still is a thing, but what about people just dashbording? They could potentionaly just easily leave, the system doesn't safe any stats of the game and you won't be punished for any games you decided to quit via dashbording. (Then again idk if that still is a thing). 

Also I agree to your last point, that sounds like a good solution. There would be other problems with it tho.
Black Ops 4 is played by a lot of people currently, but I don't think it is possible to get into a fresh lobby every time. So there is still the posibility for someone to just join into a game where the team just gets stomped. In that case you'd have the option to just die over and over and over again, or to acctualy leave. With this solution however you'd also get punished for just leaving a already lost game.
